elements.title: PYTHON CODE
elements.details: Screenshot of Python code for k-Means clustering on a dataset 'FungusLocations.csv'. Code imports pandas, matplotlib.pyplot, KMeans and silhouette_score from sklearn. It reads data, builds a KMeans model with 3 clusters, fits the model, calculates silhouette score, and plots a scatter plot of 'East' vs 'North' colored by cluster labels with title 'k-Means Clustering Result'. The resulting silhouette score printed is 0.77.
elements.summary: This code snippet demonstrates how to perform k-Means clustering with 3 clusters on a dataset and visualize the clustering result, along with calculating the silhouette score to evaluate cluster quality.
